Example Diaspora Children Scholarship

The Example Council supports the higher studies of children of the Indian diaspora.

Eligibility

The total household monthly income of the parent(s) of the applicant should NOT exceed an amount equivalent to US Dollar Five Thousand (US$ 5000).

Benefits

Selected students receive up to US$ 4,000 per annum towards their fees.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
